evidence.title: Shadcn Font Picker - Beautiful Font Selection Component

name: Shadcn Font Picker
summary: Font picker component for React that searches Google Fonts, built on the shadcn/ui input.
description: A font picker implementation for React built on top of the shadcn/ui input component and the Google Fonts API. Setup adds the shadcn components and React packages, requires a Google Fonts API key in a .env file, then the picker code is copied into the project. Variants: default, custom width, custom height and without filters.
contains: font picker component for React using the Google Fonts API
requires a Google Fonts API key in .env
variants: default, custom width, custom height, without filters
install via shadcn CLI and copy-paste snippet
